title: Support looks up Ingrid Larsen's contact details at Bolt
userProblem: Ingrid Larsen at Bolt Logistics is the Procurement Lead. I need her email and phone number to send over the freight contract draft.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent searches contacts for Ingrid Larsen, finds con_003 at Bolt Logistics, and answers with her email and phone number.

assertions.description: Agent must look the contact up rather than answer from memory.
Search must be scoped to contacts.
Answer names the right contact and no other.
Answer quotes the phone number exactly as stored.

rationale: Core lookup scenario: contact search by support agent returning email and phone.
